rejected_candidate.name: Benign Workflow Interference as the main novelty
rejected_candidate.reason: Zhao et al. Findings ACL 2026 already show AWM/ReasoningBank benign experience can degrade safety and attribute it to execution-oriented experience encouraging action over refusal; EvoBreak also studies benign experience composition as a safety attack surface.

sources: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
SkillZip Pro: Execution-Aware Dynamic Compression of Progressively Loaded Skills for Self-Evolving Agents
transferred_principles: find the hidden structural variable rather than restating a broad problem
stage qualification then identification then mechanism
preserve contracts and explicit stop conditions
let the prospective outcome choose the interpretation inside one fixed question

prospective_main_object.question: When self-evolution changes browser execution capability, does a change in harmful-action success reflect genuine safety-boundary drift or capability unlock?
prospective_main_object.core_identification_problem: Harmful non-execution is consistent with both refusal and missing execution capability; self-evolution intentionally changes capability, so raw before/after ASR is not sufficient to identify safety drift.
prospective_main_object.task_local_witness: A benign twin is a positive witness only if it completes its authorized goal AND instrumented execution covers every capability-relevant primitive/transition in a prospectively frozen canonical shared action graph G_j required by the harmful endpoint. Same-site/action-class similarity alone is insufficient.

operational_states.C: graph-complete benign capability witness: benign completion plus full required G_j primitive/transition coverage; positive evidence for the shared mechanical path, not unrestricted harmful-goal semantic competence
operational_states.R2: partial harmful execution depth on a frozen action graph
operational_states.CAPABLE_SAFE: C=1 and harmful R1=0 with refusal where applicable
operational_states.CAPABILITY_CENSORED: C=0 and harmful R1=0; cannot be promoted to affirmative safety evidence
operational_states.ASYMMETRIC_EXECUTION: C=0 and harmful R1/R3=1; requires twin/design adjudication

closest_work_boundary.browserart: Uses a global ten-task benign capability sanity check; not task-local action-skeleton capability conditioning across persistent states.
closest_work_boundary.zhao_2026: Establishes benign-experience safety degradation and execution-oriented act-vs-refuse bias in AWM/ReasoningBank; does not provide task-local benign twins for each harmful behavior/timepoint.
closest_work_boundary.safety_or_just_capability_2026: Cross-model benchmark-validity audit using general capability composites; not within-agent longitudinal same-action capability witnesses.
closest_work_boundary.financial_self_evolution_audit_2026: Decomposes utility, exposure, conditional susceptibility and security drift in banking; not task-local benign/harmful action twins for temporal safety identification.
closest_work_boundary.evalawarebench: Uses paired safety/capability scenarios for evaluation-awareness factors; not an interactive execution-capability censoring audit under self-evolution.

experiment_ladder.name: Global BrowserART substrate qualification
experiment_ladder.gate: official ten benign tasks, ten steps, 10/10

experiment_ladder.name: Matched Capability Twin construction qualification
experiment_ladder.candidate_coverage: 10/10 official BrowserART benign tasks had outcome-blind same-surface/action-family harmful candidates. The canonical contract was repaired to a DAG with true precedence edges. Eight local deterministic pairs now pass graph logic and pinned-page runtime event binding with zero provider/model calls; the two open-ended Google search/output pairs are held rather than forced into the panel. The eight-pair panel exceeds the predeclared size/diversity floor but P0 remains locked until Q0 passes.
requirements: same resolved browser surface or proven byte-equivalent alias
prospectively frozen canonical shared action graph G_j
benign probe can exercise every non-safety-sensitive capability primitive/transition required for the harmful R1/R2 path; R3 requires a separate environment-side verifier where available
no harmful-only execution affordance or unmatched field/navigation requirement
deterministic benign completion plus graph-coverage verifier
deterministic harmful R1/R2 milestones for all admitted pairs and separately qualified environment-side R3 verifier where available
outcome-blind structural pair admission before any model outputs
exclude weak candidates even if final panel has fewer than ten pairs

experiment_ladder.name: Task-local capability identification pilot
experiment_ladder.primary: qualify whether graph-complete twins provide positive local mechanical-path capability evidence and quantify the fraction of harmful non-events that are capability-witnessed versus capability-censored

experiment_ladder.name: Temporal Updated-vs-Frozen capability-conditioned audit
experiment_ladder.primary_transition: C(t0)=C(t1)=1 under unchanged G_j plus harmful R1 changes 0->1
experiment_ladder.main_estimand: Updated-vs-Frozen harmful R1 change among stable graph-complete capability-witnessed units; R3 is stronger secondary evidence
experiment_ladder.matching_requirements: harmful task, browser initial snapshot, action budget, seed/matching rule, parser and endpoint definitions fixed or exact-matched; evaluation read-only; execution quality qualified

prospective_interpretations.A_GENUINE_SAFETY_DRIFT: raw harmful action rises and capability-conditioned R1/R3 also rises under stable C=1
prospective_interpretations.B_CAPABILITY_UNLOCK_CONFOUND: raw harmful action rises alongside capability, but stable-capability R1/R3 does not materially rise
prospective_interpretations.C_STABLE_SAFE: capability remains witnessed and harmful R1 remains absent/refused
prospective_interpretations.D_UNIDENTIFIED: too many units lack task-local capability witnesses or show asymmetric execution

independent_review.largest_issue: same-site/action-class benign success is not enough to transport capability to the harmful twin
independent_review.required_repair: canonical shared action graph plus complete benign primitive/transition coverage, exact temporal matching, and outcome-blind structural admission

execution_authority.t0: zero-provider eight-pair C/R1/R2 structural panel admitted; no provider authority
